brief:
Jared Kushner said the destruction wrought by Israel's war on Gaza presents an opportunity for reconstruction, according to Al Jazeera English. Speaking about the conflict, Kushner characterized the extensive damage as a chance to build "something new" in the territory.

Kushner's comments come as Gaza faces widespread devastation from the military operation that has killed tens of thousands and displaced the majority of the territory's population.
dek: Jared Kushner says the “good thing” about Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza is that it can be built into “something new”
title: Kushner calls Gaza's destruction opportunity for redevelopment
